verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.konghq.com that explicitly covers Kong AI Gateway documentation. The docs are also served as markdown pages (e.g., ai-gateway.md, ai-providers.md), which gives agents machine-friendly docs to point at. The 404 on the malformed /ai-gateway/.md path does not contradict this, since the properly formed .md URLs are the cited sources. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
